name: Shear-Alfvén wave dispersion
description: Excite a broadband transverse velocity perturbation and recover the shear-Alfvén dispersion relation ω = v_A k with Struphy’s linearized MHD solver.
equationsMarkdown:
**PDEs solved by model:**

Momentum:

$$
\rho_0 \frac{\partial \tilde{\mathbf{U}}}{\partial t} = (\nabla \times \tilde{\mathbf{B}}) \times \mathbf{B}_0
$$

Induction:

$$
\frac{\partial \tilde{\mathbf{B}}}{\partial t} - \nabla \times (\tilde{\mathbf{U}} \times \mathbf{B}_0) = 0
$$
